on_state_breakpoint.rule: max Vds where golden input[0] >= 0.95*vgs_on (from YAML), clamped to vbus so no breakpoint exceeds the bus

cap_error.method: finite-difference dQ/dV of the emitted (V,Q) pairs vs measured C(v) on the common measured grid; relative to local C, denominator clipped at 0.1% of peak C

algorithm.cdg_data_limitation: Only a Vgs=0 C(V) sweep is available, so CDG is emitted on V(di,gi) using the identity Vdg=Vds. No bias-aware Cgd table exists and no bias axis was synthesized.

cv_bias.data_limitation: Only one persisted C(V) sweep at Vgs=0 is available; no multi-bias C-V set exists. Charge tables are fitted from that single sweep and no bias axis was invented from scalar equivalents.

curve4_cv.data_limitation: Only one persisted C(V) sweep at Vgs=0 is available; no multi-bias C-V set exists. Charge tables are fitted from that single sweep and no bias axis was invented from scalar equivalents.

algorithm.breakpoint_formula: greedy pwl_charge_segments farthest-point rule on anchored Q(V); no point cap; CDS/CDG forced DPT on-state breakpoint; no breakpoint above vbus

hybrid_channel.knee_selection: deterministic greedy: scan supplied Vds grid in ascending order, add knee minimising global RMSE, tie -> lowest Vds
hybrid_channel.knee_scope: shared across the Vgs family (one per-row list in vds_knees)

source_rows.target: Curve-1 breakpoints_id (same spec as Tier-2 channel)

hybrid_channel.known_limitation: measured 2-pulse DPT Vds RMSE regressed vs closed Tier-2: TI 11.20% vs 6.06%, CPM2 7.10% vs 2.79% (local://hybrid_channel_feasibility.md, 2026-11-20). Static fidelity only; transient superiority not demonstrated.

channel_candidates.selection_rule: FIDELITY-FIRST ONLY: hybrid is selected ONLY IF, for both charge modes, it strictly improves Vds RMSE, Id RMSE and abs(rel err) of tr/tf/e_on/e_off over the corresponding Tier-2-channel candidate on the same forced-2ns DPT guard. Adaptive speed is NOT measured in this selection step and is not fabricated: it is deferred until fidelity passes, and a caller holding measured adaptive results may re-evaluate with adaptive_results. Else Tier-2 channel.

ann_residual_candidate.selection_rule: EVIDENCE-GATED ONLY: tier2+ann_residual is selected only when both the tier2 and residual DPT runs are complete and the residual strictly improves Vds RMSE, Id RMSE, abs(rel err) of tr/tf/e_on/e_off and their mean fidelity score on the SAME selected charge-table emission.
